### Law_DegenerateCapsuleIsSphere

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 38](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L38)

```plato
// A capsule whose two endpoints coincide at the origin is a sphere. Cross-checks
// the segment-based capsule against the closed-form sphere.
Law_DegenerateCapsuleIsSphere(p: Point3D, radius: Number): Boolean
    => DistanceToCapsule(p, Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), radius)
        .LawEq(DistanceToSphere(p, radius));
```

```plato
// The vertical capsule is the general capsule running from the origin along Y.

Law_VerticalCapsuleIsCapsuleAlongY(p: Point3D, height: Number, radius: Number): Boolean
    => DistanceToVerticalCapsule(p, height, radius)
```

### Law_ConeIsDegenerateCappedCone

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 75](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L75)

```plato
// A cone with its apex at the origin opening along +Y is the capped cone that
// tapers to nothing, once the capped cone's centred frame is shifted onto the
// cone's apex-at-origin frame. Guarded to the body's own precondition: the half
// angle must be strictly between zero and a quarter turn.
Law_ConeIsDegenerateCappedCone(p: Point3D, halfAngle: Angle, height: Number): Boolean
    => halfAngle.Sin <= 0.0 || halfAngle.Cos <= 0.0 || height <= 0.0
    || DistanceToCone(p, halfAngle, height)
        .LawEq(DistanceToCappedCone(
            Point3D(p.X, p.Y - height * 0.5, p.Z),
            height * 0.5,
            height * halfAngle.Sin / halfAngle.Cos,
            0.0));
```

### Law_ExtrudedCircleIsCappedCylinder

```plato
// Extruding a circle along Z is a capped cylinder about Z — the same solid the
// spatial primitive describes about Y, so the axes are swapped to compare.
Law_ExtrudedCircleIsCappedCylinder(p: Point3D, radius: Number, halfHeight: Number): Boolean
    => ExtrudedDistance(DistanceToCircle(Point2D(p.X, p.Y), radius), p.Z, halfHeight)
        .LawEq(DistanceToCappedCylinder(Point3D(p.X, p.Z, p.Y), halfHeight, radius));
```

### Law_BoxIsBoxSlice

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 121](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L121)

```plato
// A rectangle is the z = 0 slice of the box with the same half-extents in x and
// y. The slice's own half-extent in z is irrelevant at z = 0 as long as it is
// not the nearest face, so it is taken larger than the others.
Law_BoxIsBoxSlice(p: Point2D, halfExtents: Vector2D): Boolean {
    var depth = halfExtents.X.Max(halfExtents.Y) + 1.0;
    return DistanceToBox(p, halfExtents)
        .LawEq(DistanceToBox(
            Point3D(p.X, p.Y, 0.0),
            Vector3D(halfExtents.X, halfExtents.Y, depth)));
}
```

### Law_PlanarTriangleAgreesWithSpatialPatch

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 311](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L311)

```plato
// The planar triangle and the spatial triangle patch describe the same shape
// once the query is coplanar with it: outside they are both the distance to the
// nearest edge, and inside the patch reports zero where the solid reports a
// negative depth. Two independently written bodies with two different inside
// tests, forced to agree.
Law_PlanarTriangleAgreesWithSpatialPatch(p: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D, c: Point2D): Boolean
    => UnsignedDistanceToTriangle(
            Point3D(p.X, p.Y, 0.0),
            Point3D(a.X, a.Y, 0.0),
            Point3D(b.X, b.Y, 0.0),
            Point3D(c.X, c.Y, 0.0))
        .LawEq(DistanceToTriangle(p, a, b, c).Max(0.0));
```

### Law_FlatQuadPatchIsFlatBox

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 346](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L346)

```plato
// The same rectangle as a patch in space is a box of zero depth, whose signed
// distance is already the unsigned distance to the patch. Cross-checks the quad
// patch's edge-vote branch against a formula with no votes in it.
Law_FlatQuadPatchIsFlatBox(p: Point3D, halfExtents: Vector2D): Boolean
    => halfExtents.X <= 0.0 || halfExtents.Y <= 0.0
    || UnsignedDistanceToQuad(
            p,
            Point3D(halfExtents.X.Negative, halfExtents.Y.Negative, 0.0),
            Point3D(halfExtents.X, halfExtents.Y.Negative, 0.0),
            Point3D(halfExtents.X, halfExtents.Y, 0.0),
            Point3D(halfExtents.X.Negative, halfExtents.Y, 0.0))
        .LawEq(DistanceToBox(p, Vector3D(halfExtents.X, halfExtents.Y, 0.0)));
```
